Leah (CSM): Quick kickoff for Amberleaf 1: need account health note, onboarding pain points, and a tight cost ops play for their upcoming review (Fri 9am PT). Who picks up the cost analysis?

Marco (FinOps): I'll take cost. Plan: 90d baseline, 30d spike table, and a 6-week forecast with a conservative/expected/aggressive scenario. Will highlight the two overnight vectorization runs.

Ivy (Solutions): I can surface the onboarding tickets: top themes are unclear default quotas and missing batch examples. I also have the nightly job manifest that caused the spike.

Omar (Sales): Renewal conversation is next week. CFO asked for a concrete mitigation path and a sample reserved quote. They'll want to see near-term wins we can implement before renewal.

Leah (CSM): Good. Near-term wins = spend cap + alerting, stagger the batch job, cache embeddings, and a starter config. Can we quantify savings for each?

Marco (FinOps): Yes 1. Saving estimates coming. I'll attach a CSV and a small chart. Also propose setting an 80% daily alert + auto-throttle rule.

alerts-bot: alert-rule: created rule amberleaf-daily-cap-80pct (id: ar-4965001111)

Ivy (Solutions): For the demo, I'll run their nightly job in staging before and after applying caching + shard staggering. Snippet I'll run:\n
```
# run shard 0..3 with stagger
for s in 0 1 2 3; do
  sleep $((s*15))
  ./run_vectorize --shard=$s &
done
```

I'll capture tokens/sec and cost/time.

Marco (FinOps): Uploaded files: https://files.redwood/amberleaf/4965001111/forecast.csv and forecast-summary.png. Note: two peak days drive 35% of the month's variance. Quick fix (cache TTL 7d + int8 quant for batch model) reduces peak token usage by ~40% in our sim.

Leah (CSM): Can someone confirm whether console can show per-route cost breakdown for a single API key? Need a screenshot for the deck.

Ivy (Solutions): Yes, console supports per-key and per-route breakdowns. I'll grab the screenshot and blur PII.

Omar (Sales): I'll draft the ask slide: 1) reserved quote options 2) temporary credit bridge 3) short SLA note for Dedicated. Will push by Tue EOD.

Marco (FinOps): Adding a hosted vs dedicated delta table and a short note: on Dedicated, some global caching layers may require additional setup (possible small perf trade-offs).

Leah (CSM): Owners and deadlines: Marco = cost + chart by Tue 2pm; Ivy = demo + screenshot by Wed 9am; Omar = asks by Tue EOD. I'll compile onboarding feedback + starter kit by Wed noon and run a deck dry-run Thu 8:30.

Ivy (Solutions): One more risk: If they switch to private VPC, we may need to ship a local cache connector. I'll include a one-slide tradeoff and a mitigation path.

alerts-bot: ticket AM-4982 updated: starter-kit checklist added

Leah (CSM): Perfect 1. Thanks team 44d I'll check in Tue morning for status.
